name: stratagems
description: Template to develop fully decentralised app and games

lan.description: Create a table from the lobby and invite the room, or play hotseat and against the AI offline
lan.preWebBuild: (cd contracts && pnpm exec rocketh-export -e lan --ts ../indexer/src/contracts.ts) && pnpm --filter ./common build && pnpm --filter ./indexer build && node web/scripts/processor-bundle.js

scripts._prepare: Runs AFTER contracts' own prepare, because the root devDepends on the contracts workspace (workspace:*, under the name contracts/package.json gives it) and pnpm runs lifecycle scripts in dependency order. Without that edge pnpm runs both at once, and ensure-deployments' throwaway deploy compiles while `contracts prepare` compiles, the two racing on contracts/cache/build-info (ENOENT on rename), which fails `pnpm i`. A repo that renames its contracts package renames it here too; it has to be the name, since pnpm orders by name and not by a link: or workspace:./path alias.
scripts._contracts:deploy: pnpm run --filter ./contracts deploy $MODE  ~~ pnpm run export -e $MODE --ts ../indexer/src/contracts.ts,../web/src/lib/deployments.ts ~~
scripts.indexer:build: ldenv pnpm run contracts:export @@MODE ~~ pnpm run --filter ./common build ~~ pnpm run --filter ./indexer build ~~ @@
scripts.indexer:index: ldenv pnpm run indexer:build @@MODE ~~ pnpm --filter ./indexer index --mode @@MODE -n @@ETH_NODE_URI_:MODE,ETH_NODE_URI@:''@: ~~ @@
scripts.zellij-attach: expand-vars zellij-launcher a $npm_package_name-attach-$MODE || expand-vars zellij -n dev/zellij-attach.kdl -s $npm_package_name-attach-$MODE
scripts.attach: ldenv -d localhost pnpm run indexer:index @@MODE ~~ pnpm run zellij-attach ~~ @@
scripts.zellij-remote-chain: expand-vars zellij-launcher a $npm_package_name-remote-chain-$MODE || expand-vars zellij -n dev/zellij-remote-chain.kdl -s $npm_package_name-remote-chain-$MODE
scripts.zellij-remote: expand-vars zellij-launcher a $npm_package_name-remote-$MODE || expand-vars zellij -n dev/zellij-remote.kdl -s $npm_package_name-remote-$MODE
scripts.build: ldenv -d sepolia pnpm run indexer:index @@MODE ~~ pnpm run --filter ./web build ~~ @@
scripts.contracts:deploy:prepare: ldenv -d localhost ask-env -f contracts/.env.local ETH_NODE_URI_@@MODE MNEMONIC_@@MODE ETHERSCAN_API_KEY:?:ETHERSCAN_API_KEY @@
scripts.zellij: expand-vars zellij-launcher a $npm_package_name || expand-vars zellij -n dev/zellij.kdl -s $npm_package_name
